text: Evidence record, not authority: why durations/cap1-system.hooks.json records exit 1 in 4 of 5 runs with every test passing (review note N9). That record's tool sent vitest's output to /dev/null, so those four runs' reasons were never kept and are Unknown per run. This probe re-ran the same tier at the same commit with the default reporter beside a no-op one, until a run exited nonzero; each run's whole output is below, copied by a script that asserts the summary lines it relies on. Cause, Observed in run 2: one unhandled vitest worker RPC timeout ("onTaskUpdate") after all 49 tests passed. Inferred, not observed: the same cause for the four recorded runs. repair-durations/cap1-system.hooks.json is an exit-0 set of 5 at d627a6b4 from the tool that now records unhandled errors and a failing run's output tail.
load1: not sampled: this probe records exit causes, and no duration in it is cited
